name: Blind deboss
sub: A mark with no ink. A die presses into the stock: the floor crushes the tooth flat, the walls take the light or the shadow, a lip rises at the edge. Move the light and the mark appears, flips, or disappears. Ink it to get letterpress.

entry.call: fx.run(o, W, H, dpr, { S, clips })

in.o: params object — keys below; every length in CSS px
in.dpr: device px per CSS px (density is physical: marks per CSS px²)

x.S: params of every effect keyed by id; the stock this prints on is read from S[printsOn]
x.clips: Float32Array alpha per name (die), from FXSET.clips('fx-06-deboss', W, H, dpr, o) on a thread with fonts
x.umask: optional: clips.umask — a typed or image mask (mShape type | image)

out.lin: Float32Array W·H·3, linear-light sRGB (encode with FX.toRGBA(R,"image",W,H))
out.ink: Float32Array W·H, absorbance / coverage (FX.toRGBA(R,"ink",…) = film positive)
out.stock: Float32Array W·H, stock height (FX.toRGBA(R,"stock",…) = normalized height map)

light.note: az = direction the light comes FROM (screen degrees; 0 = right, 90 = below); el = elevation above the sheet

deterministic: yes — every random draw is a hash of (position, seed); same inputs → same pixels in the same engine

params.label: Die
params.note: what the die (or type) is: the ø co. brandmark, a word, or a ring seal

params.label: Text
params.note: set in Archivo 800 for word and seal

params.label: Size
params.note: die height as a share of the plate

params.label: Die softness
params.note: wall width — how sharp the die edge is

params.label: Lip
params.note: paper pushed up just outside the edge

params.label: Crush
params.note: how flat the tooth is pressed on the floor

params.label: Floor burnish
params.note: pressed fibers read a touch darker on the floor

params.label: Ink · C

limits.why: most hues leave sRGB above ~.26 and get chroma-reduced

params.note: OKLCH chroma; reduced at constant L/h if it leaves sRGB

params.label: Color rule
params.note: film = Beer–Lambert absorption in linear light (physical); oklab / oklch / linear / srgb = coverage mixes, for comparison

params.label: Seed
params.note: every random draw in the effect hangs off this one number

recipe: Die = the ø co. brandmark, a word, or a ring seal, rasterized as an AA clip on the main thread (fonts).
Plate profile = the clip blurred by the die softness; lip = a wider blur minus the plate (only outside the edge).
Height (CSS px) = stock height × (1 − crush · plate) − depth · plate + lip — the tooth flattens on the floor.
Light: Lambert from the combined height + a height-field shadow toward the sheet light (the wall on the light side falls in shadow).
Optional ink on the floor (film), so blind → letterpress is one dial.

limits.what: reads as a carved gouge, not a deboss
walls alias; > 3 px the edge goes mushy
a blind deboss vanishes under overhead light — by design

testVector.skipped: needs main-thread text/path rasterization for its clips; render lift/fx-06-deboss.html to compare by eye
